name: product_ux_gate_lite_v1
description: Paste one product flow plus screenshots or a Figma link and get a 5-minute go-or-revise UX gate for onboarding, checkout, approval, dashboard, or landing-page flows. Returns structured JSON with one decision, one primary fix, P0 blockers, and fast sprint-ready next actions.

url.description: URL of the product to review. Can be used as a shorthand — surfaceType, artifactLinks, and other fields will be inferred.

focus.description: What to focus the review on, for example onboarding flow or checkout experience.

surfaceType.description: Surface under review, for example web app, dashboard, mobile app, or landing page. Defaults to 'web app' when url is provided.

productSummary.description: Short summary of the product and why this surface exists.

targetUser.description: Primary user or decision-maker for this flow.

primaryGoal.description: Main user outcome the screen or flow should optimize.

primaryFlow.description: Critical happy path written as a short sequence.

artifactLinks.description: One or more links to screenshots, staging pages, Figma frames, or docs.
